hero.title: AI That Doesn't Just Reply, It Gets the Work Done
hero.subtitle: Cekat.AI's agentic AI goes beyond answering questions. It creates orders, checks shipping costs, opens tickets, triggers follow-ups, and updates your CRM, taking real actions inside every conversation, 24/7

definition: Agentic AI is artificial intelligence that takes actions to complete tasks, not just answering questions, but doing the work like creating orders, checking shipping costs, and opening tickets. On Cekat.AI, agentic AI acts inside every conversation across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, and website chat, so each chat ends in a completed action instead of a promise to follow up later.

Cekat.AI's agentic AI keeps going, it creates the order right in the conversation, including shipping cost, payment, and customer details. faq.a: Agentic AI is artificial intelligence that takes actions to complete tasks, not just answer questions. Where a normal chatbot replies with information, agentic AI does the work, like creating an order, checking a shipping cost, opening a ticket, or updating a customer record, directly inside the conversation.

faq.q: How is agentic AI different from a normal chatbot?
faq.a: A normal chatbot recognizes questions and returns answers. Agentic AI understands intent and then acts on it, completing orders, calling APIs to check ongkir, routing complaints into tickets, and updating the CRM. The customer gets a finished result, not just a reply telling them what to do next.

faq.q: What actions can Cekat.AI's agentic AI actually take?
faq.a: It can create orders from a conversation with shipping cost and payment, check ongkir and book appointments through connected APIs, auto-create and route support tickets, trigger reminders and follow-ups, and create or update CRM cards, moving contacts through Visitor, Lead, and Buyer stages automatically.

faq.q: Can the AI create an order by itself?
faq.a: Yes. During a chat, the agentic AI can build the order including shipping cost, payment, and customer details, then confirm it with the customer. The order is captured without your team opening a spreadsheet or a separate system, the whole thing happens inside the conversation.

faq.q: Does it work across WhatsApp, Instagram, and other channels?
faq.a: Yes. The agentic AI acts inside conversations on WhatsApp, Instagram DM, Facebook Messenger, and website live chat, all through one unified inbox. The same actions, orders, tickets, follow-ups, CRM updates, are available no matter which channel the customer messages from.

faq.q: What happens when a task needs a human?
faq.a: The AI hands off to the right team member with the full conversation context attached, so the customer never has to repeat themselves. You set which cases stay with the AI and which escalate, and during set working hours your team handles chats while the AI covers everything after hours.

faq.q: How does the AI decide when to act?
faq.a: Actions run on workflow triggers you define, time-based schedules, specific chat keywords, or changes in customer data such as a new lead. When a trigger fires, the AI carries out the connected action, whether that's sending a reminder, opening a ticket, or notifying a teammate.

faq.q: Is my data safe with agentic AI acting on it?
faq.a: Cekat.AI is an official Meta Business Partner and complies with Indonesia's UU PDP data-protection law. You control which actions the AI can take and which cases require human approval, so automation stays accountable and sensitive decisions always reach a person.

faq.q: Do I need to code to set up agentic actions?
faq.a: No. Actions and workflow triggers are configured with no coding, you connect the APIs you use, set the rules, and the AI handles the rest. Most teams get their agent taking real actions the same day they start, without a developer.
